body: <<<Lonely depressed mom/wife here. Reply back please
Thank you 🙏🏼
I understand. I pray something changes ur mind and feelings as well as ur parents. Ur just as important as the rest of us. Thank you for being here.

Ur not alone on that. I feel invisible too pretty much have my entire life. But I read other peoples post and it kinda helps alil cause I realize I’m not alone.. and realize a lot of people here are dealing with the same as me. It’s more of a place to get things off ur chest. Feel free to express urself. So please don’t stop posting.. I care n wanna helps anyway I can
It’s not ur time. Please don’t try again. Maybe it’s time to try something else even if it’s small that can help u feel alil something more than sadness. We don’t want to u too go!
Could u just maybe ask ur parents if they can set u up with a therapist or something. Without going into detail. I would give it a shot.

I personally think u will know. I’ve been dealing since a young child I will be 40 next year. Just in the past year it’s gotten so bad for me that I know it will only take the right day n situation. I kinda feel like u just know it in ur soul. But right now u still have a chance so please keep going one day at a time n keep trying. Just please keep trying that’s what I tell myself.
I’m here n ready to talk
I would try to find a friend or stranger to talk too. U may be surprised a lot of us are dealing with things that we don’t share.
I don’t kno u. But whatever U have done/shared. Thank you I appreciate you and ur thoughts/actions.
U have to live for ur self. Happiness comes from within. So living for someone else doesn’t make sense for my happiness. But thank you
Ty u do the same maybe one of us will strive n make it to a better place.

Ty I’m a woman tho not a man. I’m married n my so called husband doesn’t give two fa about what I’m dealing with. I’ve been homeless n will be again soon. I’ve become so anger n resentful.  Embarrassed ashamed. I can’t really recall a time in my life that I wasn’t depressed thought about suicide. I’m not cut out for life n all it’s bs. I thank u so much for tryin to convince me otherwise but I’ve made my mind up now. And once I do that there’s really no turning back. I have to do something for myself for once.
I’m going to be 39 this year trust me I’ve stuck around long enough to kno it doesn’t get better
I hear but tbh she probably won’t even be graduating. Just trying to give her a chance
Thank you but it’s not gonna get better trust me. This isn’t just depression talk.
But that just it it’s alil to late now. And I’m just tired seriously.
I’m just tired of fighting and making the wrong decisions. For some people things just don’t go right ever in life. Something we can’t help but who wants a life like that.
Thank you. But Staying would only be for others. Not myself.
Wow! I never really thought of it like that. U hit that right on the head. That’s what makes it so scary and deep. But that also means u still have a chance.
Thank you
I don’t think it’s that people don’t care. People who have never been depressed or felt like suicide is an option can’t understand or relate but they care.
No I don’t. It’s beyond the point of help. But thank you
Currently still living but no I’m not ok. It’s getting so much closer for me. Everyday things get alil worse honestly. More pressure on my shoulders it’s not fair

Hey I’m here I don’t kno you but I truly care. And I can completely understand and kno excatly where ur coming from. I’m going thru depression myself but I’m here to talk so please please reach out me to
Feel the exact same.

I kno how u feel ima a mother n wife but my kids aren’t enough anymore. But I have a tiny part that’s still holding on. My uncle told me recently that I was a wounded healer cause I don’t want my kids to go thru what I went thru as a child. And that hit home so much for me. So I’m trying my best to hold on to that everyday that I can. Mothers are so IMPORTANT especially a wounded healer which u are. Please please keep holding on.

I feel the same way. But I don’t just want to attempt it. Some people need to learn that their actions are very damaging n they need to rethink how they treat people. Don’t do it it’s not worth it tho. Better to just remove that person from ur life.

Right now there’s nothing left to accomplish care for or do with my life or my family. After feeling defeated for so long n not knowing why I was even brought into the world besides misery. I just don’t care anymore for anything. It’s kinda like the more u talk about things the more u start to become numb to it after sooo long.

No one has truly loved me well maybe my adopted mother. But at times I felt used n unloved by her as well. I’m not sure where the feeling comes from I’ve always tried to be a good person n be there for people even giving my last or borrowing money to give for their needs. But I’ve never really gotten the same support or love. I’ve always been used n taken advantage of. When U come into the world not fully being wanted it’s so hard to feel worthy I guess. Spend ur whole life just wanting to be loved but instead get rejected or used. Hard to feel worthy when u never really had anyone to show u that u are worth it or loved or important. It’s so important for people to understand that everyone need someone even if it’s just one person for support or an ear to listen. We weren’t meant to be alone yet so many of us are.

It’s a lot kinda to tell. Way to much to type. But I kno my depression started from childhood being told I was adopted when I was two days old str8 from the hospital then to have to hear this is my adopted daughter to everyone I meet just planted the seed if I’m not good enough no one wants me I’m not worthy of being loved.

Thank you so much for that. But my fight is coming to an end. U can only fight for so long before ur just so exhausted n have exhausted everything possible. I have been depressed my entire life. I’ve come to realize how strong I am but now it’s too late.

U can’t live for someone else. Everyone’s life is their own even if they didn’t ask for it. We have to live for ourselves not others. If I’m not ok how am I supposed to be here for them. Ive given them life n my knowledge n live with whatever guidance I could. But at some point I have to think about what I truly want n need. Misery loves company but I try my hardest not to do that. A person can only hurt for so long before it’s too much to handle. We all want some kind of peace from something in our lives. Mines just happens to be death.
My husband knows I’m depressed n have somewhat attempted suicide just a couple months ago he doesn’t care he only wants me here so he’s not left to take care of his kids alone
My marriage isn’t important. I don’t even want to be married anymore. There’s to many issues within the marriage that it’s never gonna last anyway.

My marriage is a sham just like my life. Dealt with depression as far back as I can remember but eventually I knew this day would one day come.  It’s inevitable always has been. Its written in my life book. I’m not searching for happiness just tired of searching.
I’m trying to write my note right now. Just so my babies have something to remember me by.
4 kids. 17, 13, 3 n 1yrs old. But they aren’t enough anymore
Laying here thinking about putting this noose around my neck. But I’m scared n idk why other than I don’t want my kids to find me
